claim: 그 영토가 영향을 받는 회원국의 당국
evidence: Art 69(4): 'The Commission shall without delay make available the request to the relevant authorities of the Member State in whose territory the seat of the establishment, undertaking, broker or dealer is situated and to the authorities of the Member State whose territory is affected.' The second Member State is a separate one (whose territory is affected); '그 영토가' ties it back to the territory of the seat and blurs the two recipients.
